data.body: Today `ddflow next --phase P-perf-metrics` returns only the READY items that live INSIDE that phase. A phase at the tail of the critical path (P-perf-metrics) then shows '0 ready / 21 blocked' with no way to see — from the same command — which upstream dependencies are themselves ready to claim. Feature: by default `ddflow next --phase <id>` should ALSO include the phase's unmet dependencies' ready items (so a lane asked to drive a phase can start the upstream blockers first); an explicit parameter (e.g. `--phase-only` / `--no-deps` / `--scope phase`) restores the current in-phase-only behaviour. The default must not disguise the phase boundary: label each returned upstream item as a blocking-dependency, not an in-phase item.
